chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would place the 'anazah (a staff or stick) in front of him when he prayed.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet place in front of him during prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on prayer etiquette, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the Prophet’s (PBUH) practice of placing an *anazah* (staff) before him during prayer. This act served both a practical purpose, such as preventing the prostration from sinking into soft ground, and a symbolic one, representing dignity and readiness for battle, thereby establishing the sunnah of using a prayer stand (mihrab or staff) in front of the worshipper.
